name: openbuild
description: Evidence-grounded specifications with iterative blind-spot closure, separate-usage-pool-first search, risk-matched bounded implementation, TDD-first delivery, and progressive review for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, and review from one durable specification
interface.longDescription: Turn ideas or existing specifications into repository-grounded plans, preserve resolved product decisions across risk-adaptive critic loops, resume at the first incomplete phase, route every code search to a confirmed separate usage pool before efficient main-pool fallback, select a risk-matched fast, balanced, or strong coding tier for one bounded writer, execute TDD-first milestones, and escalate only on evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use Build in auto mode to turn this idea into a blind-spot-checked, reviewed implementation.
Refine an existing specification against the current repository.
Execute a ready specification with progressive review.
